info.title: Summer API
info.description: Curated, tested game-dev models: 3D, images, video, voice, sound and music, into your Summer assets.

bearer.description: Your Summer API key (sk-summer-v1-...), kept in SUMMER_API_KEY. Make one in Summer: Settings > API keys.

code.description: A stable code: invalid_input, not_signed_in, no_credits, rate_limited, ...

param.description: The field to fix, such as input.prompt or Idempotency-Key.

fix_url.description: Where the person fixes it, such as adding credits.

get.description: List the curated game-dev models of the Summer API: ids, capability, input schema, output formats, typical time and price. Public; no sign-in. Next: models.estimate for one request.

schema.description: Only this kind: image, 3d, video, voice, dialogue, sound or music.

topUpFeePercent.description: Added to pay-as-you-go credit purchases; model prices carry no other fee.

aliases.description: Each <capability>/default alias and the model id it runs.

datedId.description: The same model, dated: shows which price check it follows.

aliases.description: The <capability>/default aliases that run this model.

latency.description: Typical seconds from start to result.

tier.description: free: welcome credits may pay for it.

wellTested.description: Summer's own surfaces run it by default.

price.description: For one unit, at the defaults.

quantityField.description: The request field that counts the units (numImages, duration, text). Absent: one unit.

minimum.description: US dollars as a decimal string.

estimate.description: A typical request; models.estimate prices the exact one.

set.description: Applies when the field is given at all.

priceUpdatedAt.description: When the price was last checked, YYYY-MM-DD.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of input for models.run and models.estimate.

voices.description: Voice and dialogue models: the voiceId values they speak with.

post.description: Price one exact job before running it: the USD amount, what makes it up and a quote id that holds the price for 15 minutes. Charges nothing; no sign-in. Next: models.run with the quoteId.

model.description: A Summer model id from models.list, such as 3d/hunyuan-3d or 3d/default.

input.description: The model's input, matching its inputSchema.

price.description: US dollars as a decimal string.

atMost.description: true: Summer decides a step while it runs; the charge can be lower, never higher.

price.description: US dollars as a decimal string.

post.description: Run one Summer API model on its input into the person's Summer assets. Short jobs come back done; long ones answer running with a job id for jobs.wait. Spends their credits; a quoteId caps the charge at its price.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A new key for each new request; the same key returns the first answer.

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description: wait=<seconds, at most 60>: answer with the finished job when it finishes in time.

model.description: A Summer model id from models.list, such as 3d/hunyuan-3d or 3d/default.

input.description: The model's input, matching its inputSchema.

quoteId.description: From models.estimate: refuse to charge more than it quoted.

id.description: Follow it with jobs.get or jobs.wait.

estimatedPrice.description: US dollars as a decimal string.

price.description: What the job charged, once known.

result.description: The finished work: asset ids and Summer file URLs.

202.description: Still running: follow job.id with GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}.

id.description: Follow it with jobs.get or jobs.wait.

estimatedPrice.description: US dollars as a decimal string.

price.description: What the job charged, once known.

result.description: The finished work: asset ids and Summer file URLs.

get.description: Read one job once: its state (queued, running, awaiting_approval, done, failed...), progress and, when done, its result. Next: jobs.wait to wait for it.

result.description: The finished work: asset ids and URLs, or the approved change.

get.description: Follow a job as server-sent events: one `job` event per change, until it finishes.

200.description: Server-sent events: job, then done, error or timeout.

post.description: Stop one of the person's jobs that has not finished: a plan agent request, a cloud build, or a publish request still waiting for the owner (its link stops working). Work already saved stays. Returns the job. Next: jobs.list.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A new key for each new request; the same key returns the first answer.

result.description: The finished work: asset ids and URLs, or the approved change.

post.description: Start an image upload (PNG, JPEG or WebP): POST every field plus the file to uploadUrl, then POST /v1/files/complete with the upload's answer.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A new key for each new request; the same key returns the first answer.

fields.description: Send each as a multipart form field, then the file as "file".

example.description: The same upload as one curl command (replace the file path).

post.description: Finish an upload from assets.upload_begin: checks it is the upload Summer signed for this person, reads the image and saves it as their private asset. Returns the asset id and size. Free. Next: assets.get.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A new key for each new request; the same key returns the first answer.

uploadSignature.description: signature from the upload's answer (not the one in fields).
